name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's meticulous nature and deep understanding of vehicle dynamics make him an invaluable asset to Caterham Motorsport's quality control team. His journey into motorsport started with karting as a teenager, quickly developing a fascination with the intricate workings of racing machines. He honed his skills through a mechanical engineering degree, focusing on precision manufacturing and quality assurance techniques. 

Alistair is committed to ensuring that every component meets the highest standards of performance and reliability. He possesses an exceptional eye for detail and a systematic approach to problem-solving, identifying potential issues before they escalate into serious problems. His colleagues value his calm demeanor and unwavering dedication to perfection. 

What sets Alistair apart is his uncanny ability to diagnose complex mechanical faults simply by listening to the engine's subtle nuances. This almost intuitive understanding, combined with his rigorous testing protocols, contributes significantly to the team's overall success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when concentrating.
Insists on using a specific brand of microfiber cloth for cleaning sensitive components.
